content: ABBA-QuPath integration pitfalls: (1) Duplicate import — running loadWarpedAtlasAnnotations multiple times without clearAllObjects() first creates duplicated atlas annotations that corrupt region-level counts. Overwrite only works if hierarchy is intact (all still child of Root). (2) Axes orientation — Allen CCFv3 axes must be verified; misalignment causes systematic coordinate errors. (3) Atlas ontology file — do not delete the ontology file saved next to the QuPath project; it is required for coordinate transforms. (4) ABBA-Transform JSON must exist in each entry's data directory before coordinate export scripts can run. (5) Detected cells must be parented under the Root annotation at detection time for per-region assignment to work — the detection region must be the Root annotation, not an arbitrary selection.
